segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַשּׁוֹחֵט אֶת הַתּוֹדָה לִפְנִים וְלַחְמָהּ חוּץ לַחוֹמָה – לֹא קָדַשׁ הַלֶּחֶם. שְׁחָטָהּ עַד שֶׁלֹּא קָרְמוּ פָּנֶיהָ בַּתַּנּוּר, וַאֲפִילּוּ קָרְמוּ כּוּלָּן חוּץ מֵאֶחָד מֵהֶן – לֹא קָדַשׁ הַלֶּחֶם.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who slaughters the thanks offering» in its proper place «inside» the Temple courtyard, «and» at that time «its» forty «loaves were outside the wall, the loaves were not consecrated.» Likewise, «if he slaughtered» the thanks offering «before the surface» of the loaves «formed a crust in the oven, and even» if the surface of all the loaves «formed a crust except for one of them, the loaves were not consecrated.»

moves.summary: rulings on when the loaves are not consecrated

positions.claim: loaves outside the wall, or not all crusted, are not consecrated by the slaughter
